observations: Photo 0: An automatic transmission with a torque converter; '70' is written on the converter.
Photo 1: A 4-cylinder engine and transmission assembly, top view.
Photo 2: Side view of the engine and transmission assembly; the intake manifold is removed, exposing the intake ports.
A white label with a barcode is visible on the transmission in photo 2, but the text is unreadable.
The items are placed on a paved ground in what appears to be a spare parts market.
Watermarks 'CHIDO MOTOR' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are present on all images.

claims.claim: We sale all types of Toyota parts

claims.evidence: No brand logos or names are legible on the parts in the photos.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical condition of the engine
risks.proof: Video of the engine running or a compression test report.
Video of the unit in operation or a diagnostic scan from the donor vehicle.

risks.risk: Exact engine and transmission model identification
risks.proof: Clear photos of the engine code stamp on the block and the transmission ID plate.
Photo showing all included bolt-on accessories like the intake manifold and alternator.
risks.if_unproven: as a bare long block with missing parts

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine model code (e.g., 2AZ, 1AR) stamped on the engine block.
Clear photo of the identification plate or sticker on the transmission housing.
Video of the engine running or a compression test result.
List or photo of all accessories included (e.g., is the intake manifold included?).
response.reason: The specific engine and transmission models cannot be identified from the photos, and the intake manifold is missing in photo 2. Accurate valuation is impossible without knowing the exact model and confirming the internal condition.
